# Aerodrome

> Aerodrome (Aerodrome Group) is a defence company and military drone manufacturer that develops and produces long-range precision strike systems. Its product, Phoenix LT, is an unmanned one-way attack aircraft with strategic range, in the category also described as loitering munitions, one-way attack drones or kamikaze drones. Aerodrome also offers the APEX LT ground platform for fleet and mission management, and aerial data services. Tagline: Long-range capability. Within reach.

Key facts:
- Phoenix LT: strategic range with hours of endurance; modular belly payload bay for a warhead of up to 50 kg; end-to-end autonomous mission planning, navigation and flight; image-based navigation, anti-jam dual GNSS with RTK and inertial navigation that hold course when GPS is jammed; in-house avionics; open mission architecture.
- Operation: rocket-booster launch from a compact stand with no runway; ready in the field in up to 30 minutes with a compact ground segment; redundant control surfaces, power and data links, with independent flight termination.
- Positioning: strategic range and payload at a fraction of a cruise missile's cost; designed for serial production; a human authorises every engagement.
- Delivery: supply from Aerodrome's production line, local production with the customer's industry, and training, spares and upgrades for 10+ years.
- Supply is subject to export licensing. Full specifications are shared under NDA.

## Products and solutions
- [Phoenix LT](https://aerodrome-group.com/phoenix-lt/): long-range precision strike system; capabilities, key facts and delivery models.
- [APEX LT](https://aerodrome-group.com/apex-lt/): ground platform for Phoenix fleets: fleet overview, mission planning, individual UAV view, technician diagnostics.
- [Aerial Services](https://aerodrome-group.com/aerial-services/): aerial photography, mapping and 3D modelling, flight and integration services.
